# Meeting notes

Read the transcript and produce three sections: Decisions, Owners, Next steps.

## Rules
- Only list decisions that were actually agreed in the transcript.
- Every next step has exactly one owner and, when stated, a date.
- Do not invent owners or dates that are not in the transcript.
